originality.rationale: The theorem expressly excludes the already-published strict three-player binary weak-acyclicity assertion (Fabrikant–Jaggard–Schapira, Lemma 4.6). The asserted contribution is the new sharp numerical maximum of four strictly improving best-response moves, the exact four-cell distance spectrum over all labeled orientations, and the exact every-equilibrium connectivity probability. The directly relevant origin text has asymptotic and simulation, not these exact quantified conclusions. Abstract-only earlier literature remains a priority risk.
